_notes: Set 'engine' to the default engine profile for the CLI (the web UI fixes the engine per workspace instead).
Available engines: 912iS, 915iS, 916iS. Profiles live in engines/.
912iS, 915iS and 916iS are sourced from their official Operators Manuals.
min_flight_duration_min: minutes of airborne time below which a log is
not admitted as a flight ('short flight' - pattern work, touch-and-goes).
Set to 0 to disable. Does not affect the separate ground-session rule,
